% A test for tex8web: a \maketitle that the document redefines, with its
% title in bold Charter at 24pt. The page shows the title in that font and
% size, as the PDF does, not in the standard title's.
\documentclass{article}
\makeatletter
\renewcommand\maketitle{{\centering
    \fontfamily{bch}\fontsize{24}{28}\bfseries\selectfont\@title\par}}
\makeatother
\title{A title in its own font}
\begin{document}
\maketitle
Some text.
\end{document}
